rq: Does the incremental ranking value of a compact fuzzy history-aware comparator change across EPSS model regimes, relative to statistical comparators evaluated on the same decision dates and candidate panels?
study_type: Retrospective exploratory secondary Q2 extension; existing historical outcomes were already seen. Not a preregistered prospective or independent test.
manuscript: UNLISTED40 remains unchanged; no UNLISTED41 manuscript is created by E01.

memberships.level: Three piecewise-linear shoulder/hat memberships with inverse-probability-weighted training empirical quantile knots at 0.10,0.50,0.90. Inverse-CDF quantiles: first cumulative weight >= quantile. All three knots must be distinct; otherwise HOLD. No test quantiles.
memberships.trend: Three piecewise-linear shoulder/hat memberships at [-a,0,a], a = weighted training 90th quantile of absolute known trend. If zero, use maximum positive absolute known training trend. If no nonzero known trend, HOLD.
memberships.normalization: Sum firing strengths, then normalize; finite nonnegative weights and positive denominator required.
memberships.missing: 9 rules only for valid history; 3 level-only rules otherwise. Missing is not stable.

consequents.objective: Inverse-probability-weighted Bernoulli negative log loss; fixed memberships; no class rebalancing or test tuning. Convex box-constrained fitting of constant consequents.
consequents.solver: L-BFGS-B in linearly prevalence-scaled coordinates; analytic gradient; objective divided by training prevalence.
consequents.initialization: all consequents equal weighted training prevalence; no random restarts
consequents.zero_support_rule: consequent stays at initialization; mark unestimated; no expert or interpretability claim

training.use: Archive-hashed derived samples; all outcome=1 rows plus sampling_uniform<0.005 rows; w=1 for positives and 200 for sampled non-events. Only within each exact fold training interval.
training.folds: inputs/folds.csv, 8 locked F01-F08; F04 separately trained before transition, then fixed throughout its test block.
training.full_logistic: Use saved locked coefficients and training standardization; require full-panel date-level AP replay agreement before admitting a four-way performance comparison.
training.reduced_logistic: Same x, delta and unavailable bit as fuzzy; original unweighted training scaler; unpenalized L-BFGS logistic max_iter=1000,tol=1e-4. Convergence warnings cause HOLD.

version_handling.primary: Keep one-week trend across upstream version boundary, as in original benchmark; only missing lag sets unavailable.
version_handling.sensitivity: If source header versions for current and lag1 differ, mark history not directly comparable; set unavailable bit=1 and numeric delta=0; apply identically to fuzzy and reduced logistic. Preserve missing and cross-version reasons separately in diagnostics, not extra unequal model inputs.

metrics: AP primary, full exact tie groups
Common-support unique-event 30-day captures with explicit outcome and observability denominators
evaluation.other_contrasts: fuzzy vs original EPSS and saved full logistic; paired version-aware effects on fuzzy and reduced logistic; no selective deletion.
evaluation.event_and_candidate_counts: Must equal locked original records exactly on every paired date. No partial date removal, surrogate candidate population, sample-only test, or cutoff relaxation.

uncertainty.method: Circular moving-block bootstrap on full chronological paired date sequence; equal-date means; zero-event dates carried as NaN, not zero.
uncertainty.new_registry: Save actual sampled indices and hash; never relabel this as the missing historical registry.
uncertainty.short_block: Block length>=number of dates is uninformative and not reported as a CI.
uncertainty.interpretation: Descriptive exploratory intervals, not equivalence/noninferiority, probability calibration, or multiplicity-controlled confirmatory evidence.

holds_preserved: original bootstrap registry absent from recovered archive
F03/A5 lineage discrepancy unresolved; do not merge saved analysis lineages
S17 correction and F04 wording correction remain to be incorporated separately
Censys/COCOON and operational risk claims not admitted
reporting: All outcomes retained, positive or negative. Similar performance does not establish equivalence. Compact rule structure does not demonstrate analyst interpretability. No guaranteed novelty/publication/acceptance. No fabricated result table or manuscript edit before evaluation gate passes.
